final: SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, COUNT(*) AS cnt, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY tr.ordertypedist) AS frac FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink WHERE ab.peercorr > 0.149 AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist ORDER BY frac DESC LIMIT 10
